It also refers to a plan called "Lifetime Partner 27: Driving Excellence," which the company says will enhance excellence across its customer relationships, its Group operating model, and its core capabilities. The site text does not describe Genpact LTD or any AI products.

The record lists no lawsuits, no products, and no MCP servers for the company.
